notes.title: V5 Released!
notes.content:
V5 has been released! Tons of new features, changes and improvements to the game. Some highlights:

http://cloud-3.steamusercontent.com/ugc/804300005226664360/E476C1B95E0ED6E2A5195034E6D81818AF71CEAD/

New Platform:
Android! You can now get TTS for PC/Mac/Linux, iOS and Android! And much more importantly you can link your accounts together - start playing a game from your PC, continue on your phone, then pick it up later on your Tablet. Plus get notifications on your Droid/iPhone/Tablet when a game is ready for you.

New Features:

Player Abilities
Players now have unlockable abilities which give you access to new tricks in game - Slide Tackle, Lob Pass, Expert Shooter and Curve Kick. Each one costs 125 points, and the limit of 300 points per player still applies - so you are going to need to customize your players to balance your team. Having an ability unlocked allows that player to use the associated Boost in game.
Reworked Boosts System
You now start each match with a set number of each Boost type, there is no longer a 8 max limit. You now have to much more careful when choosing to use a precious Combo Boost.. 
Powerups
You can optionally choose to enable Powerups when starting new games*. The game will randomly generate Powerups into empty squares on the pitch. If one of you players runs into one, your Boost count will increase for whichever type of boost you just collected. If an opponent gets it first, it’s gone, and the ball is kicked through a powerup it will disappear. 
Adjustable Game Length
When starting a Solo game, or when challenging a friend (live or resumable) you can choose how long the game will be - 30, 46 or 60 turns.
Offside
As is so often the case with offside, this one might be controversial… You can no longer pass the ball past the last defender. 
Extra Time/Injury Time
If a game is about to come to an end, and the score is still tied, a random amount of extra turns will be added to the game.
In-Game Chat
During games there is a new chat icon (next to the opponent team’s name) to open the chat panel. Messages are exchanged at the end of the current turn. Please be nice to each other.
Taller Goal
The Expert Shooter Ability allows you to shoot at top row of targets when shooting at the goal. The goal has been made taller so that you can use this to shoot over the heads of defenders (if done correctly)
More Points
In addition to new players starting with more points, points are now acquired must faster. 
AI Formation
The AI Team (Evil Machines) now changes its teams formation quite frequently.
New House / Lighting Model
The play area for the game (the background house setting) and the lighting have been changed. I’ve removed the stadium lights (shadows were just too crazy). Shadows can now also be turned off/on in the Graphics Settings. 
ToolTips
There are now ToolTips in a few places - the Customize Players page (to explain what all the stats actually do), and in the game (over the boost icons, the chat button, the turn timer) Should be helpful for new players, you can turn off the tooltips in Settings -> General screen.

notes.title: V5 - Boosts and Abilities!
notes.content:
http://cloud-3.steamusercontent.com/ugc/222193264448115438/22B9A05A39905281F841BF3362557BF7102F73E3/
Greetings!
Quick update on the abilities and boost changes coming in V5 - which should be ready very soon, at this point I'm doing mostly bug fixes, and fixing up the UI for the changes I've already made. The thing I'm leaving till last is improving the AI, mostly Because I could spend months trying to make a better AI and you might all appreciate if  I pushed out all these other changes before spending a few weeks just on AI alone!

There is another news item on the other changes that are coming in V5, in this one I just want to talk about boosts and abilities!

Today
So today, there are boosts in the game and each player can use 8 boosts of any kind during a match. Skill points can be used to upgrade individual player skills. 

Boosts In V5

 Firstly, some boosts have been removed in V5 - Marking Mode, Extra Time are no longer available.
 Secondly, each boost type now has a limited number of uses per match. For example, you get 2x Speed boosts, 3xCombo boosts, etc. Basically you are going to have to be a lot more mindful when you choose to use a boost.
 Finally, the Curve Shot has become an Ability


So why is this happening?! Couple of reasons, but mostly to support the new Abilities feature (below) and also so that in a later version I could add a mode that would allow boosts to be collected like power ups on the pitch... 

Abilities In V5

 In addition to the skills that you can enhance for players today, you will now be able to unlock Abilities for your players.
 Abilities are expensive - 125 points. You still have a 300 point limit per player, so if you want to unlock 1 or 2 abilities for a player, you need to sacrifice something else! This means greater variation in players.
 The good news is that the abilities are pretty awesome! There are 4 total, and most of them enable a Ability specific boost for a given player. These ability based boosts do not have a limit per game, so you can use them any time. Here is the breakdown of the abilities that are in V5:

 Curve Shot - This allows the player to activate the Curve Shot Boost. It works just like the current curve shot boost today (except I have fixed it so that you can't do crazy shots that bend into the goal sideways)
 Lob Pass - This one let's the player use the new Lob Shot boost - as you would expect it let's you lob the call at a very high arc allowing you to pass over your opponents players
 Slide Tackle - this one let's you have a player perform a slide tackle. It works just like moving the player, so you still have to decide where you want the slide to end up, but the main difference is the player sliding moves significantly faster, allowing you to quickly snag the call from an opponent. It also has a cool new animation
 Lastly is Expert Shooter Ability. This one is a little different in that it's a passive ability (there is no associated boost). A player with this ability has a significant advantage in terms of shooting accuracy, and more importantly they can shoot to the upper row of goal targets any time - whether a direct shot, or a combo shot. Players that don't have this ability will not be able to shoot at the upper row of targets. This is important because in V5 the goal is taller, meaning those high shots are a lot harder to block.



Finally, players that have an abilities have a little icon by their name that shows which ones they have.

As always your feedback is most welcome - here, private message or email (admin@tabletopsoccer.com)

notes.title: Fixed - Linux Startup Problem
notes.content:
100% credit for this fix goes to xekarfwtos - who recently found out there are some missing files with the linux install for this game.

100% of the blame for this problem, goes to me of course.. It will be fixed in the new version. In the meantime, xekarfwtos has figured out how to work around:


If you have another Steam Game installed on your system, search for the following two files:

 libCSteamworks.so
 libsteam_api.so

 Copy these two files into the following directories where ever TableTop Soccer is installed:

 TableTop Soccer/TableTopSoccer_Data/Plugins/x86
 TableTop Soccer/TableTopSoccer_Data/Plugins/x86_64



One outstanding problem (again, my fault) is that you will not get any sound. Again, will be fixed in the upcoming V5 build.

Huge thanks to xekarfwtos for figuring this out, and sharing the fix with everyone on the discussion boards.

notes.title: What's coming in V5? (And when?!)
What's coming in V5? (And when?!)
Totally Crazy Idea About Powerups
notes.content:
Greetings! Firstly, thank you to everyone that has contacted me with ideas and suggestions for what you want to see in the next version of TTS, I really appreciate the feedback from everyone - you guys have some awesome ideas! :) 

Mashing up a couple of these ideas lead me to an interesting thought tonight, and I'm curious what you guys think... I think it has the potential to change things up quite a bit - but not sure 100% sure if it would be a good way! 

Right now, each side starts every match with 8 boosts, (the power, speed, combo, time, delay, etc stuff at the top of the screen).

What if you started with 0 boosts, and you have to collect them, like powerups throughout the match.

For example, say every 3rd turn, 1 or 2 boosts are randomly generated, and randomly placed into an empty grid on the pitch. This would force players to then have to try to collect these boosts to use them.. A few things this would do:

 Encourage players not to bunch up as they would want to collect boosts;
 Add a little spice to each match, certain plays wouldn't be possible in every match if you dont have the right boosts;
 Give me an opportunity to do some sort of cool* effect when a boost is collected.


It could also be that this only includes certain boosts, I could make some of them constant/infinite. For example:

Infinite / Always On Boosts

Curve Shot
Delay
Extra Time


Collectable Boosts

Combo Shot
Speed Boost
Power Pass
Marking Mode


Let me know what you think!

notes.title: Version 4.4 Released!
notes.content:
Very happy to announce that version 4.4 has arrived.

Huge thanks to all the players that submitted feature requests and bug reports. It's really really helpful to get ideas from actual users, I'm always listening - so keep your ideas coming! Feel free to message me, post to the developer to-do list page, or use the features in game to submit bug reports or new feature ideas!

Anyway - here's a run down of whats included in V4.4!

New Features:

Added in 3 new spots to shoot for the goal! There are now two rows, top and bottom, each with 3 possible spots to shoot at the goal.

The new goal shoot choices allow you to shoot over opponents trying to block the goal!!. Get around those cheeky defenders lined up in front of the goal by shooting over their heads! With just one caveat.....

You cannot shoot for the top row when doing a Combo Boost (i.e pass & shoot in one turn). So if you have the ball, and you just go for a regular shot, you can shot for the top or bottom row, but if you do a combo shot, you can only select from the bottom row. 

Added post goal celebration animation for scoring player. There are 15 animations for celebrations, which are selected randomly anytime you score a goal! 

Changed the running speed stat - Level 1 (50pts) allows you to run normal speed when you have the ball, Level 2 (100pts) also lets you run 1 extra grid when you dont have the ball.

Added in new Team Stats page that shows details about wins/losses for all games, solo games and penalty shootouts, and info about which players on your team have scored/missed goals. Page is accessed from either the My Team page, the Leaderboard page, or the Friends page. Keep in mind that data about old games prior to this update, will not be tracked.

Players can now saved up to 3 replays for watching anytime. Your saved replays can be seen in the new Stats page, which also lets other players watch games you have saved. You can save the replays from the post game screen, or from the replays panel. If you already have 3 replays saved, and you save a new one - one of your existing replays will be replaced.

You can now resume Resumable Games to Live Mode! If you have a Resumable Game going with a friend, and both of you are online, you can go to the Friends page, and you will be able to "Resume Game To Live!". This works similar to the challenge friend system, one player initiates the challenge to resume, and then the other player can then accept it. If the challenge to resume to live is accepted, the game will start back up wherever you left it off, but in live mode!

Resumable Games now have a time limit for each turn. Each player gets a max of 5 days to complete their turn, if they fail to make a turn within that time then the game is forfeit.

Enhanced the Tutorial to include an explanation for the Marking Mode boost and Delay boost. Go through the tutorial to check out the new explanation and understand what all those boosts actually do!

Pulled out AntiAlias graphics options to a separation option within the graphics page. You can set AntiAliasing to Off, 2x, 4x, 8x. 


Fixes:

Fixed a problem with the start new resumable game button getting hidden after you clicked it once. It not should only get hidden, when you are at the limit of active resumable games. (Which is currently 13)

Fixed an issue where the keepers model and name were not getting swapped correctly at half time.

Fixed a bug where sometimes the popup waiting for server would appear even though it didn't need to..

Prevented being able to challenge someone when they are modifying their formation, or customizing their team as it would lead to a bad state in the game.

notes.title: Version 4.3.8 Released!
notes.content:
Another update with some fixes for some issues reported by players. I have a more significant update planned in the next week or so that will add some new content and features, including a time limit on resumable games, better balancing of player points, more ways to shoot goals- but before working on any of that exciting stuff I wanted to get these bugs fixed up!
Here are the changes for this version:


Fixed a problem where the camera could (rarely) get stuck in the first person camerea after a combo shot was blocked, or when watching a replay of a game where this happened.

Reduced the goal keeper skill effectiveness slightly, players with levelled up goal keepers were getting a little too hard to score against! GK Saving Skill will still make a difference, but it is less than before.

Fixed a problem where after a combo shot, during a resumable game, the ball could suddently jump back to the player that originally passed the ball. This would have resulted in one player seeing the "A Conflict Was Detected" popup.

Fixed a problem where sometimes during a replay, or more likely, when watching the recap when resuming a Resumable game ,the ball would start in the wrong place. This was mostly when resuming around the half-time turn.

Fixed a problem where replays of penalities the ball would appear to be stuck to one of the keepers hands. This only happened in cases where the last move of the game was the keeper throwing in the ball after saving it.

Further improved handling games where a user loses internet connection mid game.

notes.title: New Version 4.3.5
notes.content:
Greetings! New version of TableTop Soccer, a couple of fixes/bugs fixed, and one new feature added that was requested by users:


It is now possible to cancel a players move if you change your mind. Previously, when you moved a player couldn't move them to where they are currently standing. This is now possible. So if you make a move, and you change you mind, just move that player to where they are standing now, and they will not move!
Fixed a problem where the menu screens could start to flicker. This wasn't happening to many people, but it was very annoying! 
Fixed a problem were the Settings Screen would default to having the Graphics page open. This is fixed so that now you are at the default settings page, where you can change Graphics, Music and Control/Other options.
Made some changes to the text in all languages when you completed your turn in a resumable Game. It used to say "Your Opponent is offline... This game will be moved to your resumable game list". I removed the "Your Opponent is offline" part, because that may not be true and it was confusing some new players, especially when you can see your opponent is in fact online... Just to clarify to anyone that is confused - a resumable game, is one where you can play taking turns with another player over a few days. So even though you are ready to continue, your opponent may not be!



I am aware of the following issues:

 One player has reported the game can crash when he runs in Windowed mode, but it works fine in Full Screen. Not sure why this is happening yet, still looking into it. If you are having this problem - please let me know asap as it will help me narrow down what is happening!
 If you play an Online game and it goes to Penalties, its possible that the game will be shifted into a resumable game. This is bcause of some code that was deployed yesterday to fix cases where a user drops internet connection mid game. The job that is searching for dropped games is running to fast, and can think that someone has dropped the game when in fact both players are waiting for penalities to render. I am fixing this now, and will be updating the server code hopefully later today, tomorrow at the latest.

notes.title: New Client And Server Code!
notes.content:
Version 4.3.4 - Will be released in about 30 mins!

Firstly, I'm really sorry about having to restart the servers when people were playing - I did send out some warning messages to people in game, this is the first restart/update on the server I have done since launch, I know its a pain but I needed to do it when I knew I would be around for a few hours to watch logs and make sure everything is OK!

Anyway - change list for this version:


 Added Support for VSync! A user asked for it on the Discussion page, and it's a great idea. 
 Game will now better support internet connection drops! This was suggested in a user review recently. If your connection goes out during the middle of the game, the following should now happen:

1 - If it is a Solo game, the game will be set to Resumable, and the next time you login the game will appear in your resumable game list;
2 - If it is a Online game, your opponent will see the message "Your opponent is now offline, this game will be moved to your resumable game list". And the game will switch into Resumable mode, where you can complete it over the next few days (or mins, wheneever you have time)
Two important notes about this!!:
a - There may be up to a 2 minute delay before a game that you dropped out on, appears in your REsumable game list. This is because there is job that now runs ont he server every 2 mins to check for dropped games. So, if you drop and then log in 10 seconds later, the game might not be there yet. Wait a couple mins and it will appear. 
b - If you play a solo game, and you drop out before you completed making moves for Turn 1, the game is just deleted. Not really worth saving it as you didnt do anything to save

Changes you make to your team stats, will no longer take effect in the middle of a resumable game. This was an exploit someone noticed, you could keep dumping your points into different skills depending on what you needed for a particular turn. This changes makes it so that you player skills stay the same for a resumable game. New games you play will always use your latest skills data.
Fixed a problem where the turn timer was too slow when you resumed a Solo Game. The slower timer should only happen when either you are very new player, or if you are playing a Resumable game with a human.
Fixed a problem where after you used a tracking boost the line color showing where you are moiving a player was always staying as the checkered line. 
 (hopefully) Fixed a bug where after an opponent forfeited a game, you could get stuck looking at an empty pitch and the game wouldnt go back to the main menu
 Significant improvements to the database to speed up querys, and cut back on old data that is no longer needed to speed things up and take less space.

Another update for TTS - This update was mostly little bug fixes, and some improvements - here is a quick rundown:


 Reduced the size of the ball.
 Reduced the amount of extra time you get when activating the time boost.
 Made changes to the ball trail effect, now it runs red to yellow.
 Changed the recover account code (mostly used when linking your account from steam to ios, or vice versa) to be 5 digits instead of 8. Basically more like the Steam two-factor authentication code. 8 characters seemed a bit too long.
 Fixed an issue where the AI would try to pass to the same grid it is already in
 Fixed several issues around challenging players which were introduced in the last build.
 Added in a few checks to validate if someone had quit the game when you were still waiting on them for a turn to render. You will now correctly see the opponent forfeited popup.
 Fixed issue with friends page, if a friend was online the first time it loaded that friend the challenge button was greyed out

notes.title: New Version Released - 4.0.20
New Version Released - 4.0.20
4.0.3 Released
notes.content:
Another new Version! Mostly some bug fixes, but added in a lot more sounds, and added in new bug reporting and player reporting system:


Fixed a bug where the Marking Boost wasnt working, marking is now back and working again.
Increased the delay to start music when the game first opens to make sure that music plays only if you saved settings where the volume was higher than 0.
Added a Ding noise that plays as you slide the music volumne slider so you can hear what level its at.
When playing games, the music track will now move forward to the next track when finished instead of just looping the same track.
Added a sound for when picking a goal shoot direction when shooting or taking a penalty
Made the 4 corner spots in the field, inaccessible. This works around an exploit where if a player with teh ball stayed in the one of the 4 corner spots, it would not be possible to tackle them and steal the ball.
Fixed a problem where the new Challenge Live Game button on the friends would show up when it wasnt supposed to.
Fixed some issues with the AI around tracking the ball and player with the ball correctly. The AI is still easy to beat, but its supposed to be!! You're supposed to be playing humans ;)
Fixed a crazy problem with the server. Its too embarrassing to talk about here, but its fixed - so let's not dwell on this one... (it was related to threading - always a good time)
Added 2 more awesome music tracks;
Added more awesome sound effects.
Fixed problem where a combo shot was pending, someone intercepted the ball, and the original combo player still tried to shoot
Reporting Player System - If you are playing a game against a Human opponent, there is now a button for "Report Player" in the in-game mini menu.
Reporting Bugs System - You can now submit bug reports or problems in game and they directly to me. You can do this from the settings screen, or from the in-game mini menu.
Several other bug fixes and improvements across the three platforms;

notes.title: New Version - 4.0.2 Released
notes.content:
Version 4.0.2!
March 26th, 2016

This update contains a lot of bug fixes, and some new features/improvements based on the feedback of the Beta testers group. Please keep the feedback coming guys!!
There are still some known issues that I am working on, see the bottom of the list for more info.

This patch is for all client - Windows, Mac & Linux.

The main focus of this version was to make resumable & live games more reliable, and consistent across clients. The "Conflict Detected" popup - should now be a very rare event...

New Features

Gameplay

FPS limit removed!(was previously fixed at 30FPS, in tested I have seen ~400 FPS during gameplay, maybe a little excessive?!)
Made the following items that sometimes need to flash, frame rate independant: Tutorial Highlight Grids, Tutorial Arrows, InGame Boost Buttons, Player Token (with ball), Turn Timer, Shoot Button, Ticker tape
Reduced the maximum running speed of a player. If that player has improved stats, they can still run farther, they just wont run as fast as before. This makes it easier to catch them, and also reduces client conflicts
Before other players start to run, the player with the ball will initiate kicking the ball first.. This reduces client conflicts, and makes it easier to pass the ball quickly when surrounded by opponent players.
Improved the in game ticker tape text to be more fluid, and update better on interceptions. 
Added in whistle sounds for Kick Off, Half Time, End Game and Penalty Shootout
Removed the creepy looking guy standing in the room near the table during replays and in the menu. IN previous version this guy represented you playing at the table, but it didnt really add anything. Except that feeling that you were being watched...

Menu/UI

Added in the standard unity launcher screen, to allow players to adjust settings before starting, or to select which monitor to play on.
Updated credits page, added in more testers. If you are a Beta Tester and want to be added to the list - let me know!
Main Menu - Resumable Game Button - When one or more games is waiting for you, you will see (x) next to the button
If you are in any menu page, and not in an actual game/replay, you will get a "Ding" noise when a Resumable game is ready for you. This is in addition to the steam notification, but should make it pretty obvious its your turn if you are customizing your team or looking at the leaderboards etc.
Tutorial Popup on first play, now offers the choice of starting the tutorial now, or later if you want to change settings etc before playing the tutorial.
Resumable Games are now split into two sections clearly showing which games are ready for you, which are waiting for your opponent.
Reworked the friends page to make it clear which friends are available now, and which are offline. 
Added new button to friends page to challenge players to live games (if they are online) and start a new resumable game if they are online.
Reworked the resumable games page to make it clear which games are waiting on you, and which are waiting on your opponent.
Added some background color to certain menu panels with a lot of text as some users had reported it was hard to read
Added a confirm popup when clicking exit game
New Icon for Combo Boost - was previously a player performing a header, which wasn't very accurate, so its now a player taking a shot.



Bugs Fixed

If Music volume was saved at 0, should no longer play when the app launches (it was playing for 1 second, then stopping) levels
If you change the music from 0, to something higher, in the middle of a game, the music will now play
Slowed down the speed of players running into positions before a game starts
Fixed a problem on the Level Up popup where the OK button was shoved over the one side and not centered
Player level on the main menu page not getting translated when switching langauge (worked after you restarted in a different language)
Changed the logo for the unity launcher, this *should* fix the issue in linux where the launcher icon was massive and grew the window too large.
Fixed a case where player names wouldnt show up when coming back to a resumable game, or after shooting.
Fixed a lot of resumable game issues around the ball appering in the correct play when resuming. A lot of this was tied to cases where someone scored, or attempted to score, and when returning to the resumbale game the ball would appear on the field incorrectly, when the keeper should have had possesion of the ball
Fixed a minor issue, with significant impact! When resuming games players previous rotation would not always be accouted for. This could lead to some inconsistent steals
Fixed a problem where sometimes the game rendering would wait for a player to complete a movement, that they dont need to do. This happened only when players were not moving at all.
Fixed so many random, annoying, hard to find issues that caused resumable games to have occasional conflicts. This will require a lot more games to be played to test this for sure, but Im confident that the amount of "Conflict detected" popups you were seeing in resumable games is now GREATLY reduced. 
Fixed an issue where in solo games you would not get points for scoring, or even winning, a penalty shootout.
Fixed the way the the level up achievement in steam was rendering, there are 6 levels - Novice, Beginner, Advanced, Pro, Expert, Master.


Known Issues

Due to some of the changes I have made above (like the player kicking happening before other players moving) replays of old games will not always play back correctly. This is because the rendering has changed, and so in the original game someone may have intercepted the ball, in the replay now that wont happen (or vice versa). This will be fixed in a later version.
If you challenge an Online Friend to a live game, and hit Cancel right away, the other player may still get the popup, they can click accept, and they will be stuck in a screen waiting FOREVER!! You can never escape (well you can quit with Alt-F4)
Due to the iOS App store deploy process, the iOS app will be out of date with this new Shiny Steam version. So basically, if you take games to go on your phone - you will probably run into some conflicts. I'll be pushing out an iOS version in the next week or so to catchup.

notes.title: New Beta Build In The Works
notes.content:
Beta testing is coming along well - thank you to everyone who has provided feedback so far, I really appreciate it!

I'm working on a new build at the moment to add in some requested features, and fix up some bugs that users have reported, here is an (incomplete) list of some of the stuff that will be updated in the new build:


New menu options and layout to make it clear how to challenge friends to Online Live games rather than Resumable games;
 Lots of fixes for reumable games - and the conflicts that users were having. This is a particulary tricky issue to solve (its a client rendering delta problem) but - I have made good progress and hope to have squashed most of the situations where this can happen in the new build
FPS limit removed - the game was previously locked at 30FPS - but I have removed that limitation, on my system I'm getting around 400-500 FPS now!
New in game "Ding" noise if a resumable game is ready for you while you are in the menu of the game. (You still get steam notifications if you are not in the game)
 Lots of fixes to resumable games - new menu
Fixes to music volume levels being saved correctly
I'll be adding the pre launch screen (Unity launch window) so that users with multiple monitors can configure the game before playing
 And other little bugs/issues that players have noticed.


Finally - if you are beta tester, and you want to be added to the credits page - let me know and I will add you in! 

Thanks again for taking the time to test TableTop Soccer - I really apprecaite all your time, effort and feedback!
